scope: Training-only grammatical augmentation and independently authored surface-form holdout. All clauses contain one explicitly delimited transfer proposition. Gold annotations are evaluation-only.
augmentation_templates: {condition} activates a clause in which {actor} {modal} send the {asset} to {recipient}; the provision records the outcome {consequence}
A declared outcome is {consequence}; if {condition}, {actor} {modal} transfer the {asset} to {recipient}
Under {condition}, {consequence} is the consequence specified for {actor} who {modal} deliver the {asset} to {recipient}
fresh_templates: The outcome {consequence} is recorded, and following {condition} the supplier {actor} {modal} pass the {asset} to {recipient}
After {condition}, a {asset} transfer from {actor} to {recipient} is discussed with consequence {consequence}; the supplier {modal} carry it out
The beneficiary is {recipient} and the supplier is {actor}; after {condition}, the contract states {duty} for transfer of the {asset}, and the result is {consequence}
new_name_policy: Uppercase proper-name candidate absent from training vocab; exactly one out-of-vocabulary name with one known counterparty is supported, otherwise fail closed
compound_condition_policy: the conjunction of X and Y has been satisfied; exactly two explicitly known atomic conditions; no implicit logical inference
